verdict: Strong ROAS momentum this period; overdue build items now need to close.
narrative: Over the last 28 days your Meta ads returned $4.05 for every $1 spent, and in the most recent 7 days purchases doubled and return on ad spend jumped 58.66% versus the week prior — the paid channel is performing well. That efficiency is running ahead of several supporting pieces that are still being completed: funnel setup, tracking, subscribe pages, and automated flows were all due by end of September and remain open, which limits how fully we can read and scale the results. Google Business Profile engagement also went dark for two consecutive days (Oct 10–11), with zero recorded actions against a prior daily average of roughly 17 — we're investigating and monitoring that closely. Ad spend is being held steady while these items are closed, so next period you can expect cleaner attribution data and a more complete picture of what's driving purchases.

highlights.phrase: return on ad spend across the last 28 days
purchases in the last 7 days versus the prior 7 days
local actions (calls, directions, website clicks) from your Google Business Profile this period

watch_item.issue: Google Business Profile recorded zero engagement actions on Oct 10 and Oct 11, a two-day gap against a normal daily average of ~17 actions — local discovery has gone quiet.
watch_item.fix: The profile is being actively reviewed and the data gap investigated this week to restore normal visibility.
